references.text: God's promise to Abraham that those who bless him will be blessed, and those who curse him will be cursed. Israel is blessed by God.
God's blessing upon Abraham's descendants, confirming that the people of Israel are blessed.
Balaam acknowledges that he cannot curse those whom God has not cursed.
Balaam confirms that he was commanded to bless and that he cannot change it.
Balaam pronounces a blessing over Israel and repeats the promise from Genesis that those who bless Israel will be blessed.
God turned Balaam's curse into a blessing because the Lord loved Israel.
Joshua reminds the people how God would not listen to Balaam but turned his curse into a blessing.
Nehemiah refers to how God turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
If God is for us, who can be against us? God's protection over His people cannot be overcome.
